mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`);\n const onChange = () => {\n setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);\n };\n mql.addEventListener(\"change\", onChange);\n setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);\n return () => mql.removeEventListener(\"change\", onChange);\n }, []);\n\n return !!isMobile;\n}"},{"path":"src\/lib\/error-capture.ts","content":"\/\/ Captures the original Error out-of-band so server.ts can recover the stack\n\/\/ when h3 has already swallowed the throw into a generic 500 Response.\n\nlet lastCapturedError: { error: unknown; at: number } | undefined;\nconst TTL_MS = 5_000;\n\nfunction record(error: unknown) {\n lastCapturedError = { error, at: Date.now() };\n}\n\nif (typeof globalThis.addEventListener === \"function\") {\n globalThis.addEventListener(\"error\", (event) => record((event as ErrorEvent).error ?? event));\n globalThis.addEventListener(\"unhandledrejection\", (event) =>\n record((event as PromiseRejectionEvent).reason),\n );\n}\n\nexport function consumeLastCapturedError(): unknown {\n if (!lastCapturedError) return undefined;\n if (Date.now() - lastCapturedError.at > TTL_MS) {\n lastCapturedError = undefined;\n return undefined;\n }\n const { error } = lastCapturedError;\n lastCapturedError = undefined;\n return error;\n}"},{"path":"src\/lib\/error-page.ts","content":"export function renderErrorPage(): string {\n return `<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n <head>\n You can try refreshing or head back home.<\/p>\n <div class=\"actions\">\n <button class=\"primary\" onclick=\"location.reload()\">Try again<\/button>\n <a class=\"secondary\" href=\"\/\">Go home<\/a>\n <\/div>\n <\/div>\n <\/body>\n<\/html>`;\n}"},{"path":"src\/lib\/lovable-error-reporting.ts","content":"type LovableErrorOptions = {\n mechanism?: \"manual\" | \"onerror\" | \"unhandledrejection\" | \"react_error_boundary\";\n handled?: boolean;\n severity?: \"error\" | \"warning\" | \"info\";\n};\n\ntype LovableEvents = {\n captureException?: (\n error: unknown,\n context?: Record<string, unknown>,\n options?: LovableErrorOptions,\n ) => void;\n};\n\ndeclare global {\n interface Window {\n __lovableEvents?: LovableEvents;\n }\n}\n\nexport function reportLovableError(error: unknown, context: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {\n if (typeof window === \"undefined\") return;\n window.__lovableEvents?.captureException?.(\n error,\n {\n source: \"react_error_boundary\",\n route: window.location.pathname,\n ...context,\n },\n {\n mechanism: \"react_error_boundary\",\n handled: false,\n severity: \"error\",\n },\n );\n}"},{"path":"src\/lib\/products.ts","content":"import prodSofaChair from \"@\/assets\/prod-sofa-chair.jpg\";\nimport prodCoffeeTable from \"@\/assets\/prod-coffee-table.jpg\";\nimport prodLamp from \"@\/assets\/prod-lamp.jpg\";\nimport prodBlueChair from \"@\/assets\/prod-blue-chair.jpg\";\nimport heroChair from \"@\/assets\/hero-chair.jpg\";\nimport roomLiving from \"@\/assets\/room-living.jpg\";\n\nexport type Product = {\n slug: string;\n name: string;\n price: number;\n was: number;\n category: string;\n img: string;\n gallery: string[];\n swatches: { name: string; Every `.tsx` file in this directory\ndefines a route. Do **not** create `src\/pages\/`, `src\/routes\/_app\/index.tsx`, or\n`app\/layout.tsx` \u2014 those are Next.js \/ Remix conventions. The only root layout\nis `src\/routes\/__root.tsx`.\n\n## Conventions\n\n| File | URL |\n| --- | --- |\n| `index.tsx` | `\/` |\n| `about.tsx` | `\/about` |\n| `users\/index.tsx` | `\/users` |\n| `users\/$id.tsx` | `\/users\/:id` (dynamic \u2014 bare `$`, no curly braces) |\n| `posts\/{-$category}.tsx` | `\/posts\/:category?` (optional segment) |\n| `files\/$.tsx` | `\/files\/*` (splat \u2014 read via `_splat` param, never `*`) |\n| `_layout.tsx` | layout route (renders children via `<Outlet \/>`) |\n| `__root.tsx` | app shell \u2014 wraps every page; preserve `<Outlet \/>` |\n\n`routeTree.gen.ts` is auto-generated. \".\/lib\/error-capture\";\n\nimport { consumeLastCapturedError } from \".\/lib\/error-capture\";\nimport { renderErrorPage } from \".\/lib\/error-page\";\n\ntype ServerEntry = {\n fetch: (request: Request, env: unknown, ctx: unknown) => Promise<Response> | Response;\n};\n\nlet serverEntryPromise: Promise<ServerEntry> | undefined;\n\nasync function getServerEntry(): Promise<ServerEntry> {\n if (!serverEntryPromise) {\n serverEntryPromise = import(\"@tanstack\/react-start\/server-entry\").then(\n (m) => (m.default ?? m) as ServerEntry,\n );\n }\n return serverEntryPromise;\n}\n\n\/\/ h3 swallows in-handler throws into a normal 500 Response with body\n\/\/ {\"unhandled\":true,\"message\":\"HTTPError\"} \u2014 try\/catch alone never fires for those.\nasync function normalizeCatastrophicSsrResponse(response: Response): Promise<Response> {\n if (response.status < 500) return response;\n const contentType = response.headers.get(\"content-type\") ?? \"\";\n if (!contentType.includes(\"application\/json\")) return response;\n\n const body = await response.clone().text();\n if (!isH3SwallowedErrorBody(body)) return response;\n\n console.error(consumeLastCapturedError() ?? new Error(`h3 swallowed SSR error: ${body}`));\n return new Response(renderErrorPage(), {\n status: 500,\n headers: { \"content-type\": \"text\/html; charset=utf-8\" },\n });\n}\n\nfunction isH3SwallowedErrorBody(body: string): boolean {\n try {\n const payload = JSON.parse(body) as { unhandled?: unknown; message?: unknown };\n return payload.unhandled === true && payload.message === \"HTTPError\";\n } catch {\n return false;\n }\n}\n\nexport default {\n async fetch(request: Request, env: unknown, ctx: unknown) {\n try {\n const handler = await getServerEntry();\n const response = await handler.fetch(request, env, ctx);\n return await normalizeCatastrophicSsrResponse(response);\n } catch (error) {\n console.error(error);\n return new Response(renderErrorPage(), {\n status: 500,\n headers: { \"content-type\": \"text\/html; charset=utf-8\" },\n });\n }\n },\n};"},{"path":"src\/start.ts","content":"import { createStart,
